summary: Kerb near the corner where cars park; homes 12-13 m behind, resident-permit signs.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 12-14 m from the kerb on its own side; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with several cars parked along this kerb, so room to stop exists.
drivers.traffic: Residential street near a junction, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; overnight is outside those hours.

flags: Steep: about 5% grade at best section
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky, with tree shade from the north-west near the 45 m mark.

best_section.where: Seventh Avenue north kerb, just up from the corner junction
